events.verdict: Wembanyama (SAS) jumps toward Camara (POR) and marginal body contact occurs prior to Camara releasing the pass.
Simons (POR) engages and disengages with Champagnie (SAS) and marginal contact occurs as Champagnie cuts along the perimeter.
Barnes (SAS) brings his left arm outward and his right hand forward prior to marginal contact occurring with Avdija's (POR) front during the drive.
Barnes (SAS) establishes himself in Camara's (POR) path and does not deliver illegal contact as he sets the pick.

Replay review of the foul called on Grant (POR) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Grant avoids making contact with the ball and instead initiates contact with Wembanyama's (SAS) right wrist, causing him to mishandle the entry pass.
Sochan (SAS) legally contests Simons' (POR) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Avdija (POR) maintains a rested right hand on Vassell's (SAS) side and marginal contact occurs as Vassell stops his forward momentum at the end of the drive.
Champagnie (SAS) is moving to align alongside Grant's (POR) path and marginal body contact occurs as the two come together during the drive and shot attempt.
Avdija (POR) and Barnes (SAS) mutually engage and disengage with one another during the inbound.
Grant (POR) is drawn into the air on the pump fake toward Wembanyama (SAS) and initiates body contact during Wembanyama's upward shooting motion.
Vassell (SAS) legally contests Avdija's (POR) jump shot attempt.
